races.title: State House, District 47
races.note: Unopposed: this seat was decided without a general-election contest, so it won't be on your ballot.

cands.name: Anthony Nieves
cands.bio: Democrat; former Florida financial-crimes investigator and New York City fraud investigator. Roman Catholic. Won the Aug. 2026 primary (53%) and is unopposed in November after Rep. Paula Stark failed to qualify.

record.text: Beat Jorge Figueroa in the Democratic primary with 53%; HD 47 covers parts of Orange and Osceola counties. Stark's paperwork failure kept the Republican off the ballot and a judge rejected her lawsuit to get back on.

money_notes.text: Florida Politics described him as "badly outraised"; he says supporters knocked on 15,000 doors.

cands.gaps: No photo, website or endorsements found. Dollar totals not retrieved.
